column1: # w-joint3 (2026-08-24) -- CENSUS KEY POPULATIONS, the cheap half of board #3509.
# HANDOFF, not a work order. Board #3509 records that Phase 1's ten constructs
# have never been mapped to census keys -- ROADMAP_SLICING_2026-08-21.md section 3
# gives an opcode for THREE of TEN -- so "can Phase 1 convert a TU" is not
# decidable from any measurement in this tree. That read is ~0.5-1 day and this
# lane declined to take it rather than guess the mapping (decision 10's lesson).
# This file is its CHEAP HALF, delivered so the read starts from counted
# SORTED BY KEY NAME, DELIBERATELY. Sorting by mass would make this a ranking,
# and the rule against dispatching off a blocked-key size ranking has bound five
# times (#3505). Every number here is a FIRST-BLOCKER count: #3131 -- the port
# stops at the first refusal by design, so each body reports one key however many
# it has, and NONE of these columns is a distance or a reach.
# blocked_bodies : first-blocker count over the census route (4C 4F 11 splitter)
# tus            : distinct TUs in which the key appears at all
# emit_blockers  : the same key on the emitted-symbol-bound population, for
#                  scale only -- a DIFFERENT denominator, never summed with the first
# scan    c2rs 77dc81022 / binary b2241a63a00e / 878 TU rows
# totals  1710066 blocked bodies over 785 distinct keys; denominator 2,417,794 slots
